work.description: Brief CLX confirms the institute, constitutions and declarations of the nuns of Perpetual Adoration of S. Anna al Quirinale and lets the abbess found and aggregate monasteries; LF36337 → LF36349 across CLIX’s provenance LF36340, own provenance LF36343 and running title LF36346; across page numbers LF36417, LF36483 and running title LF36548; complete 23 January 1838 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF36332–36332; the source closing at LF36573–36576 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima tertia ianuarii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo octavo, pontificatus Nostri anno septimo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
